validation.validation_report_summary: SCS Global Services (VVB-SCS-0021) validated the Mida Creek Mangrove Restoration Project against VCS v4.5 and methodology VM0033 v2.1. The validation confirmed the project boundary of approximately 1,200 hectares, the additionality demonstration, the baseline scenario, and the monitoring plan. Four findings were raised during the desk review and site audit, all of which were resolved before the final validation report was issued. The validation team concluded that the project design conforms to the applied standard and methodology.
validation.validation_stage_description: Desk review of the project design document and supporting evidence, followed by a site audit at Mida Creek with community and project team interviews, a 30-day public comment period hosted on the registry, resolution of four findings raised by the validation team, and issuance of the final validation report.

status.validation_status_reason: Four findings raised during the desk review and site audit were addressed by the project developer and closed by the validation team in April 2023.
Final validation report issued on 2023-05-10. The validation is valid until 2028-05-10, after which the project must be revalidated to maintain its registry standing.
